verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents support for many LLM providers selected as `provider/model`. Its models page covers a `/model` chat command, which suggests per-conversation switching, and community reports show Anthropic (via Claude CLI), OpenAI/Codex, Google and local models in use. However, the evidence never lists the named providers (OpenRouter in particular) and never shows models assigned per agent, so the story is only partly covered. missing for 10: an explicit provider list covering Anthropic/OpenAI/Google/OpenRouter, documented per-agent model configuration, detail on per-conversation `/model` switching behavior, independent hands-on corroboration of switching.

support.subject: As a power user, I can plug in multiple model providers — Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, and more — and switch models per agent or per conversation

citations.quote: OpenClaw can use many LLM providers. Pick a provider, authenticate, then set the default model as `provider/model`.
